'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Kryvyi Rih strikes (2022–present)|Kryvyi Rih strikes]]
***The [[Government of Ukraine|Ukrainian government]] declares April 6 as a [[National day of mourning|day of mourning]] following yesterday's [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] missile strike on [[Kryvyi Rih]] in [[Dnipropetrovsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]], that killed twenty people, one of the [[Attacks on civilians in the Russian invasion of Ukraine|deadliest strikes]] since the start of the invasion. [https://www.volkskrant.nl/buitenland/een-van-de-dodelijkste-russische-aanvallen-ver-van-de-frontlinie-dompelt-kryvy-rih-in-rouw~baba6afe/ (''de Volkskrant'')]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[2025 Shabelle offensive]]
***Colonel Nur Farey, the senior [[Somali Armed Forces|Somali military]] commander of the 14th brigade, is assassinated by a man believed to be an [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] militant in Addow Dibille near [[Afgoye]], [[Lower Shabelle]], [[Somalia]]. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Apr/200987/senior_somali_army_commander_killed_during_troop_visit_in_lower_shabelle_region.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Tariffs in the second Trump administration]], [[List of executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump|Executive orders in the second presidency of Donald Trump]]
**[[Donald Trump's Liberation Day speech|Executive Order 14257]]
***The first of two [[tariff]] rounds go into effect in the [[United States]], containing a 10% blanket tariff on every import into the country. The second round of [[Liberation Day tariffs|country-specific tariffs]] is scheduled to go into effect on April 9. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/us-starts-collecting-trumps-new-10-tariff-smashing-global-trade-norms-2025-04-05/ (Reuters)]
***[[United Kingdom|UK]]-based [[Multinational corporation|multinational]] car manufacturer [[Jaguar Land Rover]] suspends vehicle exports to the United States for a month to evaluate the impact of Trump's tariffs on the [[automotive industry]]. [https://www.foxbusiness.com/politics/uk-based-jaguar-land-rover-puts-pause-shipments-us-amid-trump-tariffs (Fox Business)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Three vehicles collided in [[Bomet County]], [[Kenya]], killing 15 and injuring 14. [https://www.tuko.co.ke/kenya/counties/584775-bomet-deadly-kericho-kaplong-road-crash-killed-15-linked-speeding-police-report/ (TUKO)]
*A car veered off the [[Pan-American Highway]] and crashed into a tree near [[Del Viso]], [[Argentina]], killing five and injuring one. [https://www.minutouno.com/sociedad/tragedia-la-panamericana-cinco-muertos-el-despiste-y-choque-un-auto-n6131267 (Minutouno)] 
*A minibus crashed into a parked truck in [[Kalaburagi]], [[India]], killing five and injuring 11. [https://english.jagran.com/india/karnataka-five-killed-11-injured-in-minibus-crash-with-parked-truck-in-kalaburagi-10228373(English Jagran)]
*Two people are killed after a [[caravan (trailer)|caravan]] catches fire at a [[campsite]] in [[Skegness]], [[Lincolnshire]], [[England]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/two-people-die-after-caravan-fire-at-holiday-park-in-lincolnshire-13342390 (Sky News)]
*Two reporters are killed after a metal structure collapses during the [[Festival Ceremonia]] in [[Mexico City]], [[Mexico]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/entertainment/music/2025/04/06/axe-ceremonia-2025-canceled-deaths-collapse/82966063007/ (''USA Today'')]
* Two tour buses collide along the [[Chūō Expressway]] in [[Hachiōji]], [[Tokyo]], injuring 47 people. [https://english.kyodonews.net/articles/-/53332#google_vignette (Kyodo News)]

*[[Israel–United Kingdom relations]]
**[[Israel]] blocks two [[United Kingdom|British]] [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]] [[Member of Parliament (United Kingdom)|MPs]] from entering the country. [https://www.reuters.com/world/two-british-mps-detained-by-israel-british-foreign-minister-says-2025-04-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[South Sudan–United States relations]], [[Immigration policy of the second Donald Trump administration]]
**[[U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Marco Rubio]] announces the revocation of all [[travel visa|visa]]s of [[South Sudan]]ese passport holders, citing "the failure of South Sudan's [[transitional government]] to accept the return of its repatriated citizens in a timely manner."
